title: Crispy Cod Tacos with Avocado and Lime
summary: Mexican-inspired fish tacos with golden crisp cod, creamy avocado, crunchy cabbage and a bright lime-yogurt drizzle. They make a fresh, satisfying pescatarian dinner for weeknights.

ingredients.name: cod fillets, cut into thick strips
plain flour, for a light crispy coating

steps: Pat the cod strips dry with kitchen paper. Mix the cornmeal, plain flour, paprika, cumin, chilli powder, salt and black pepper in a shallow bowl. Put the beaten egg in a second bowl.
Dip each cod strip into the egg, then press into the cornmeal mixture until evenly coated. Set the coated pieces on a plate while you prepare the toppings.
Toss the shredded red cabbage with 1 tablespoon of the lime juice and a pinch of the salt from the measured amount if desired. Leave it to soften slightly while the fish cooks.
Stir the plain yogurt with the remaining lime juice and the sriracha until smooth. Taste and adjust with a little extra salt if needed.

Heat the vegetable oil in a large frying pan over medium-high heat. Fry the cod in batches for 2–3 minutes per side, until the coating is crisp and golden and the fish flakes easily. Drain briefly on kitchen paper.
Warm the corn tortillas in a dry frying pan for about 30 seconds per side until pliable and lightly toasted.
Fill each tortilla with red cabbage, crispy cod, sliced avocado, spring onion and coriander. Drizzle with the lime yogurt sauce and serve immediately.
